title: Cambodia and Vietnam Tour Package
highlights: Embark on a journey through Vietnam and Cambodia, exploring their landscapes, rich cultural heritage, and iconic attractions.
Cruise through Halong Bay in Vietnam and admire its 1900+ limestone islands and islets.
Wander through the ancient temples of Angkor Wat in Cambodia which hold a Guinness record for being the world’s largest religious structure.
Visit Cambodia’s Tonle Sap Lake, Southeast Asia’s largest freshwater lake to explore its unique floating villages, and enjoy a glimpse into the local way of life.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a journey through the ancient mysteries, legends, history, and natural wonders of two of South Asia's most captivating destinations—Vietnam and Cambodia. Discover Vietnam's stunning landscapes, from towering cliffs and picturesque river valleys to pristine coastlines, all intertwined with remnants of its storied past, offering an adventure that blends history with breathtaking natural beauty.
In Cambodia, immerse yourself in the country's rich cultural heritage and spiritual depth. Explore the majestic temple ruins, where intricate architecture and timeless grandeur tell tales of a bygone era. Beyond the UNESCO Heritage sites, delve into the heart of Cambodia's countryside by cruising the serene waters of Tonle Sap Lake in a traditional boat, providing a glimpse into the local way of life and creating memories that will last a lifetime.

know_before_you_go: ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check in. Later, get driven for the Hanoi sightseeing tour and explore iconic attractions like the Temple of Literature, Hoa Lo Prison, Sword Lake, and more. Also, enjoy cycling (extra cost) in the Old Quarters of the city and then get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh Province
days.desc: Make your time memorable in Vietnam as you embark on a day trip to Ninh Binh Province from your hotel. Upon reaching Hoa Lu, visit the temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties. Later, enjoy a boat trip from Hoa Lu to Tam Coc, and witness the limestone mountains. After the boat trip, cycle from Tam Coc to Bich Dong Pagoda while relishing the views of beautiful rice paddy fields, before being transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise Experience
days.desc: On this day, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Tuan Chau Harbour from the hotel. Upon reaching, check in and get ready to enjoy the views of towering limestone cliffs and hidden caves as you sail through the bay. Later, visit the Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. After you return to the cruise, participate in a cooking class and learn to make popular Vietnamese dishes. Later, spend the night on the cruise.

Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your overnight cruise from Tuan Chau Tourist Wharf in Halong Bay and receive a warm welcome with delicious lunch and drinks. 
Take a small boat to explore neighboring islands, relaxing at its coast or taking a swim, before proceeding to visit the Pearl Farm village for an interactive experience. 
Learn about the traditional dishes and flavors during your cooking class on the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi
days.desc: Begin your day by enjoying various activities on board, including Chinese martial art - Tai Chi. Later, go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and witness formations hanging from the ceiling. After lunch, disembark at Tuan Chau Harbour and get transferred to the hotel in Hanoi. Check in and spend the remaining day exploring nearby attractions on your own like the Temple of Literature and the Hanoi Opera House before returning to the hotel.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, explore the seven new wonders of the world in Halong Bay.
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace by exploring places like Ben Thanh Market and the Dong Khoi Street, among others. After exploring the place on your own, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Have a fun-filled day, as you board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel for the Ho Chi Minh City tour. Visit the War Remnants Museum to learn about the Vietnam War and its effects. Next, you will explore Reunification Palace and Saigon Central Post Office, before heading to Cu Chi Tunnels. The tunnels offer insights about Vietnamese history and the resourcefulness of the Viet Cong. After the tour, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing day, as you get transferred from the hotel for the Mekong Delta tour. You will be dropped off at Vinh Trang Pagoda, an architectural masterpiece blending Asian and European styles. From here, you'll go on a boat ride along the Mekong River to My Tho and explore Tortoise Islet. After a day of exploration, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Tour of Angkor Wat
days.desc: Spend an amazing time as you explore Angkor Wat on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from the hotel to the Bayon Temple and learn about the royal culture and history by visiting the Royal Enclosure and Leper King Terrace, among others. Continue your day tour by visiting Thommanon, Chaosay Tevoda, and Ta Kel temples. At last, explore the wonderful Angkor Wat, and learn about the Hindu mythology stories written on its walls. Later, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
